changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 4a: the routing document, access.json, and chat-bots.json are now each held in memory for the session's life through one shared TransactionalStore primitive (issue #448), replacing the routing store's own write logic, the access mutex, and chat-bots' inline temp-file writer. access.json and chat-bots.json used to be re-read from disk on every operation; a hand edit to either file while the daemon is running is no longer picked up until the daemon restarts (the routing document already worked this way). access.json no longer writes PendingPairingEntry.kind/.replies or the last_gate/observed_chats/warnings ledger fields (old files that still have them keep reading; PendingPairingEntry.created_at is unaffected and still written); the 'warn once per dispatcher run on multi-chat traffic' log event is gone, replaced by chat_id on the existing per-message pair log lines. Public exports changed: TRUST_DOMAIN_WARNING, loadDispatcherAccess, saveDispatcherAccess, and listChatBots are removed, and defaultDispatcherAccessState()'s shape shrank by the three deleted ledger fields.
